_comment: The sixteen layers, shared by discovery, classification and rendering. `queries` feed the GitHub search sweep; `keywords` place a candidate when no judgement exists yet; the agent decides real membership.

coding-agents.title: Coding agents
coding-agents.blurb: You use it to write and change code. You are its user, not a builder on it.
coding-agents.keywords: coding agent|code agent|pair program|cli agent|ide|editor|swe|vibe coding|codebase

research-agents.title: Research and knowledge agents
research-agents.blurb: Agents that go and find out: deep research, document analysis, report writing.

browser-agents.title: Browser and computer-use agents
browser-agents.blurb: Agents that drive a screen: browsers, desktops, phones.

assistant-agents.title: Personal and desktop assistants
assistant-agents.blurb: The agent that sits next to your work and does errands across your own tools.

clients.title: Clients and interfaces
clients.blurb: The chat window, terminal UI or desktop shell you put in front of an agent.

harness.title: Harnesses and agent runtimes
harness.blurb: The loop you build on: tool execution, context management, turn control. Opinionated, not a library.

frameworks.title: Frameworks and SDKs
frameworks.blurb: Composable libraries for building an agent: handoffs, structured output, graphs.

skills.title: Skills and instruction assets
skills.blurb: Files you load into an agent: skills, prompt packs, AGENTS.md collections. No code to run.

orchestration.title: Orchestration, durability and deployment
orchestration.blurb: What keeps an agent alive between turns: queues, retries, state, serving.

memory.title: Memory and context
memory.blurb: What the agent remembers after the session ends.

gateways.title: Model gateways, routing and account switching
gateways.blurb: Everything between your agent and whichever model answers: proxies, routers, key and account switchers.

protocol.title: MCP, protocols and registries
protocol.blurb: The standards agents speak, the SDKs that implement them, and the registries tools are published to.

capability-tools.title: Capability tools
capability-tools.blurb: What an agent reaches for: search, scraping, documents, data access.

sandboxes.title: Sandboxes and execution
sandboxes.blurb: Where the agent's code is allowed to run.

evaluation.title: Evaluation and observability
evaluation.blurb: How you find out whether the agent is still doing its job.

security.title: Security and guardrails
security.blurb: Stopping an agent from being talked into something, or taking the system with it.
